A1.name: Sniper Long
A1.rule: Monthly and weekly are both in green regime, and the daily fires green today.
A1.summary: The canonical 3-timeframe confluence entry — backbone up, swing up, today's daily flip is your fresh trigger. Highest-probability long setup.

A4_premium.name: Premium Sniper
A4_premium.rule: A Sniper Long where the monthly Trend Strength is ≥60.
A4_premium.summary: Sniper Long filtered to the strongest backbones. Removes weak 'technically aligned' names.

A2.name: Weekly Trigger Long
A2.rule: Monthly in green regime, weekly fires green today, daily already in green regime.
A2.summary: Slower, stronger confirmation than A1 — weekly flips are rarer and more durable. The trend has more room to run.

A3.name: Early Weekly Trigger
A3.rule: Monthly in green regime, weekly fires green today, daily neutral (no fire).
A3.summary: Weekly just turned but daily hasn't joined yet. Earlier than A2 — better price, slightly more risk.

B1_triple_green.name: Triple Green Cascade
B1_triple_green.rule: Daily, weekly, AND monthly all fire green on the same bar.
B1_triple_green.summary: Major regime shift across every timeframe simultaneously. Extremely rare, very loud — worth a dedicated alert.

B2_WM_green_D_already.name: Backbone + Swing Establishing
B2_WM_green_D_already.rule: Weekly AND monthly fire green today; daily already in green regime.
B2_WM_green_D_already.summary: The macro and swing trends are being established THIS bar. Stronger than A2 because the M backbone is fresh.

B3_DW_green_M_already.name: Daily + Weekly Burst (Bull Macro)
B3_DW_green_M_already.rule: Daily AND weekly fire green today; monthly was already in green regime.
B3_DW_green_M_already.summary: Inside an existing bull macro, both faster timeframes flip together. Sharp swing-trade entry.

B4_DW_green_counter_macro.name: Counter-Macro Burst
B4_DW_green_counter_macro.rule: Daily AND weekly fire green; monthly NOT in green regime.
B4_DW_green_counter_macro.summary: Faster TFs flip up against a non-bull macro. Short-term mean-reversion trade only — lower conviction.

D2_regreen.name: Dip-Buy Completion
D2_regreen.rule: Monthly and weekly in green regime, daily fires green today, with a daily red fire within the last 10 bars.
D2_regreen.summary: The pullback finished and the trend resumed. A Sniper Long at a better price because you waited for the dip.

D1_pullback.name: Pullback in Bull Stack
D1_pullback.rule: Monthly and weekly in green regime; daily fires red today.
D1_pullback.summary: Healthy retrace inside a trend. Not an entry alone — watch this ticker for re-green (D2) at better price.

C2_D_green_W_recently_g.name: Weekly Turned, Daily Confirms
C2_D_green_W_recently_g.rule: Monthly still red, weekly flipped green within last 5 bars, daily fires green today.
C2_D_green_W_recently_g.summary: Two of three aligning bullish before the macro turns. Second-derivative bottom signal — confluence is building.

C1_first_D_green_deep_red.name: First Green After a Deep Red
C1_first_D_green_deep_red.rule: Monthly and weekly in red regime, daily fires green today, prior daily-red regime was at least 60 bars deep.
C1_first_D_green_deep_red.summary: First daily green after months of selling pressure. Early bottom-fishing — low hit rate, big payoff when right.

C3_first_D_red_deep_green.name: First Red After a Long Bull
C3_first_D_red_deep_green.rule: Monthly and weekly in green regime, daily fires red today, prior daily-green regime was at least 60 bars deep.
C3_first_D_red_deep_green.summary: First daily red after a sustained green run inside a bull. Doesn't mean exit — means tighten stops / take partials. Critical risk signal.

H4_tops_forming.name: Top Warning — Daily Red After Long Bull
H4_tops_forming.rule: Monthly in green regime, daily fires red today, with prior daily-green regime ≥30 bars.
H4_tops_forming.summary: Softer cousin of C3 — same idea (first daily red in a bull) with a less strict threshold and no W[g] requirement.

E1_stack_red_D_trigger.name: Sniper Short
E1_stack_red_D_trigger.rule: Monthly and weekly in red regime; daily fires red today.
E1_stack_red_D_trigger.summary: Mirror of Sniper Long. Highest-probability short trigger in an established bear.

E2_triple_red.name: Triple Red Cascade
E2_triple_red.rule: Daily, weekly, AND monthly all fire red on the same bar.
E2_triple_red.summary: Major bear regime shift across every timeframe. Mirror of B1.

E3_DW_red_M_already.name: Daily + Weekly Burst (Bear Macro)
E3_DW_red_M_already.rule: Daily AND weekly fire red today; monthly already in red regime.
E3_DW_red_M_already.summary: Sharp short-side momentum inside an existing bear macro. Mirror of B3.

G1_bull_stack.name: Full Bull Stack
G1_bull_stack.rule: Monthly, weekly, AND daily all currently in green regime (any age).
G1_bull_stack.summary: The healthiest names — long-only buy universe. Use this to hold winners rather than chase entries.

G1_young.name: Fresh Bull Stack
G1_young.rule: Full Bull Stack where at least one TF flipped recently (D ≤ 5 bars, W ≤ 4, M ≤ 2).
G1_young.summary: The stack just came together. Likely to have more upside ahead of it than an established stack.

G1_mature.name: Established Bull Stack
G1_mature.rule: Full Bull Stack where every TF is well past its flip (D ≥ 20, W ≥ 12, M ≥ 6).
G1_mature.summary: Stable, long-running bull. Use for momentum continuation rather than fresh entries.

G1_premium.name: Premium Bull Stack
G1_premium.rule: Full Bull Stack with monthly Trend Strength ≥ 60 AND weekly TS ≥ 60.
G1_premium.summary: Quality filter — keeps stacks where both higher TFs are showing real momentum, not just technical alignment.

G2_bear_stack.name: Full Bear Stack
G2_bear_stack.rule: Monthly, weekly, AND daily all currently in red regime.
G2_bear_stack.summary: The weakest names. Short universe or simply 'avoid going long.' Mirror of G1.

G2_young.name: Fresh Bear Stack
G2_young.rule: Full Bear Stack where ≥1 TF flipped recently.
G2_young.summary: Stack just came together — typically more downside ahead than an established bear stack.

G2_mature.name: Established Bear Stack
G2_mature.rule: Full Bear Stack with every TF well past its flip.
G2_mature.summary: Long-running bear. For continuation rather than fresh entries.

H1_bull_stack_cracking.name: Daily Currently Red in Bull Stack
H1_bull_stack_cracking.rule: Monthly and weekly in green regime; daily in red regime (not necessarily today's flip).
H1_bull_stack_cracking.summary: The state version of D1. A bull stack with the daily currently against — pullback-watch pool.

H2_swing_rolled.name: Swing Rolled, Backbone Holding
H2_swing_rolled.rule: Monthly in green regime; weekly in red regime.
H2_swing_rolled.summary: The weekly has already turned even though the monthly is still up. More serious than H1 — close watch.

H3_bottoms_forming.name: Macro Red, Daily Green
H3_bottoms_forming.rule: Monthly in red regime; daily in green regime.
H3_bottoms_forming.summary: Macro hasn't turned but the daily already has. Early bottom-watch list — pre-confluence.
